title: Summit Club Reduction on Summit Top-Up Miles
content:
Summit Club lounge members pay less per thousand miles on a Crestline Summit Loyalty Program top-up purchase. The reduction follows the member's Summit Club membership under the Crestline Summit Club Lounge Memberships charter, as its product and status show on its record.

| Summit Club membership | Status | Taken off per 1000 miles (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Summit Club Executive, Summit Club Corporate or Summit Club Lifetime | Active | 2 |
| Summit Club Essential, Summit Club Individual or Summit Club Individual Plus | Active | 1 |
| No active Summit Club membership | | None |

The reduction is a dollar amount per thousand miles taken off the net price per thousand.

**Hypothetical figures.** A net price per thousand of 33.25 USD becomes 31.25 USD with an active Summit Club Corporate membership and 32.25 USD with an active Summit Club Individual Plus membership. A lapsed Executive membership takes nothing off.
